WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT category,
         AVG((NULLIF(spent, 0) - amount) * 1.0 / amount) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM budget
  GROUP BY category
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT step1.category, step1.avg_ratio, step1.record_count,
         step1.record_count - step2.avg_count AS count_difference
  FROM step1
  JOIN step2 ON step2.avg_count IS NOT NULL
  WHERE step1.record_count > step2.avg_count
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(record_count), AVG(count_difference)
FROM step3
